description: This Java source file defines the InstallerService class, which manages installation and uninstallation of APK files within the F-Droid client app. It handles sequential install/uninstall operations, deletes associated OBB files upon uninstall, and provides static methods to initiate install/uninstall actions.
external_methods: Installer.sendBroadcastInstall(Context, Uri, String, App, Apk, Object, Object)

classes.name: InstallerService
classes.description: A service that handles APK installation and app uninstallation, including cleanup of OBB files, based on Android's JobIntentService.

methods.name: onHandleWork
methods.description: Processes incoming intents to perform install or uninstall actions based on the intent's action.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Static method to initiate APK installation from a URI, broadcasting the start and enqueuing the service.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Static method to initiate app uninstallation, broadcasting the start and enqueuing the service.

methods.name: enqueueWork
methods.description: Helper method to enqueue work for the service.
